title: A Feasibility Condition for Confidence-Gated Tiered LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.05394v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tiered inference distributes large language model computation across a hierarchy of devices, from on-device and edge hardware to the datacenter, and is increasingly offered as the route to cheaper, lower-latency, and more private serving. Most such systems orchestrate frozen model checkpoints, and most decide what to resolve locally and what to escalate using a confidence signal produced by a forward-deployed model. We give a closed-form condition for when no threshold on that signal makes a tiered cascade worthwhile relative to sending every query to the backstop. Modeling the routing decision as a binary test and separating local from escalation cost through an architecture cost ratio $\kappa$, we derive a feasibility condition bracketed by a signal-free floor, below which a cascade is feasible at any signal quality, and a perfect-signal ceiling, above which none is. translated_title: 置信度门控分层式LLM推理的可行性条件
translated_abstract: 分层推理将大语言模型的计算分布在一个设备层级结构中，从端侧和边缘硬件到数据中心，并且日益被视为实现更廉价、更低延迟和更隐私保护的服务途径。大多数此类系统协调的是冻结的模型检查点，并且大多依靠前置部署模型产生的置信度信号来决定哪些查询在本地解决、哪些需要升级。我们给出了一个闭式条件，用于判断何时该信号上的任何阈值都无法使分层级联相对于将所有查询直接发送给后备模型更有价值。通过将路由决策建模为二元测试，并借助架构成本比 κ 来区分本地成本与升级成本，我们推导出了一个可行性条件，该条件由一个无信号下界所界定——低于该下界时，级联在任何信号质量下都可行；同时由一个完美信号上界所界定——高于该上界时，级联不可行。沿 κ 轴来看，该条件会发生反转：在本地计算……
tldr: 本文提出了一个由无信号下界和完美信号上界界定的闭式可行性条件，通过架构成本比κ刻画了置信度门控分层LLM级联推理何时优于将所有查询直接发送到后备模型。
en_tdlr: This paper derives a closed-form feasibility condition, bracketed by a signal-free floor and a perfect-signal ceiling, that determines via an architecture cost ratio κ when confidence-gated tiered LLM cascades are worthwhile compared to routing all queries to a backstop.
